_comment: Provider/model fingerprints this repository has seen and accepted.
Read by scripts/check-fingerprint.mjs against the fingerprints persisted in run
bundles under .nexusprompt/runs/. A provider reporting a fingerprint that is not
listed here fails the build and names the baseline suite to re-run.
ARMED since 31 August 2026. This comment said the watch was empty and that no run
had ever reached a provider, which stopped being true the moment the CLI could name
a local model. It also named .promptnexus/runs/ — the pre-ADR-0009 directory the
checker read while nothing wrote to it, which is why the watch reported 'not armed'
through every run that would otherwise have armed it.
What is pinned below is LOCAL models only, reached over loopback at no cost. No
hosted model has answered, and no evaluation figure in this repository came from any
of these: the suites still run against the pinned stub. See TRUTH_BOUNDARY.md.
Treat every later change as what it is: a regression you did not introduce.
Accepting a new fingerprint means re-running the named baseline suite and comparing,
not appending a string — and `--write` appends the string, so it is for the first
observation of a provider, not for silencing a drift report.

ollama-local.note: Re-run the baseline suite and compare before accepting a new fingerprint.
